component_rules: Extract shared paragraph properties into ParagraphStyleSpec instead of duplicating body, heading, TOC, bibliography and header/footer models.
Extract repeated DOCX font, alignment, indentation, spacing and pagination conversion into one paragraph-style translator.
Keep semantic heading and keyword recognition in one compiler-owned document context state machine.
Keep TOC tabs, paragraph borders, document grid and header/footer relationships in focused DOCX helpers.
Reuse bibliography data and text formatters without importing DOCX presentation behavior.
